notes.title: Client-Server Update Released!
notes.notes:
A new patch is now available on Steam. With this update, both the client and server can handle multiple stacks of items.

Previously, the game could only recognize one stack of any particular item. This limitation is now resolved. Players no longer have to consolidate their items into a single stack - the client and server will efficiently manage multiple stacks!

notes.title: Awakening Update
notes.notes:
[i]So for the first time i am using steam to release my patch notes, It's recently been brought to my attention that some users who have access to the game do not use [url=https://discord.gg/zBfahDA7Zn]Discord[/url] so from now on i will be releasing the patch notes via steam.[/i]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[u]In this update i am aiming to test how many different kinds of enemies the server can handle in a single channel. Because of this server stability may not be great during the initial testing of this update.[/u]

[b][u]If you would like to support the development of "Anime Collector: EVO" please consider checking out our [url=https://www.patreon.com/squidsaround/]PATREON[/url] page. As of this update we will be updating all reward tiers.[/u][/b]

As of this update i will also be updating the Steam Store Page and all related details to the game.

[b]Server will come ONLINE in 15 minutes[/b]
